sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "devices" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "device_key" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "manufacturer" TEXT NULL, "model" TEXT NULL, "device_name" TEXT NULL, "android_version" TEXT NULL, "sdk_int" INTEGER NULL, "build_fingerprint" TEXT NULL, "first_seen_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "last_seen_at" INTEGER NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "device_hardware_profiles" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "device_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES devices (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "scanned_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "tier" TEXT NOT NULL, "confidence" TEXT NOT NULL, "abis" TEXT NOT NULL, "cpu_description" TEXT NULL, "cpu_cores" INTEGER NULL, "total_ram_bytes" INTEGER NULL, "gl_renderer" TEXT NULL, "gl_es_version" TEXT NULL, "vulkan_supported" INTEGER NULL CHECK ("vulkan_supported" IN (0, 1)), "display_width" INTEGER NULL, "display_height" INTEGER NULL, "raw_json" TEXT NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "device_compatibility" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "source" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("source" IN ('detected', 'community', 'verified')), "manufacturer" TEXT NOT NULL, "model" TEXT NOT NULL, "chipset" TEXT NULL, "cpu_architecture" TEXT NULL, "cpu_characteristics" TEXT NULL, "gpu" TEXT NULL, "ram_bytes" INTEGER NULL, "android_version" TEXT NULL, "graphics_api" TEXT NULL, "emulator_id" TEXT NULL, "console_id" TEXT NULL, "tested_game" TEXT NULL, "test_result" TEXT NULL, "performance_notes" TEXT NULL, "known_limitations" TEXT NULL, "compatibility_date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "import_batch" TEXT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "emulators" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "license" TEXT NOT NULL, "strategy" TEXT NOT NULL, "requires_arm64" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("requires_arm64" IN (0, 1)), "min_sdk" INTEGER NULL, "console_ids" TEXT NOT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "consoles" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "manufacturer" TEXT NOT NULL, "category" TEXT NOT NULL, "folder_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "extensions" TEXT NOT NULL, "min_tier" TEXT NOT NULL, "recommended_tier" TEXT NOT NULL, "enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("enabled" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "games" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "sort_title" TEXT NOT NULL, "console_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES consoles (id), "preferred_emulator_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES emulators (id), "added_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "last_played_at" INTEGER NULL, "play_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "is_missing" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_missing" IN (0, 1)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "compatibility_test_results" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "device_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES devices (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "emulator_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES emulators (id), "console_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES consoles (id), "game_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES games (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "result" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("result" IN ('excellent', 'good', 'limited', 'unsupported', 'notTested')), "source" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("source" IN ('local', 'community', 'verified')), "notes" TEXT NULL, "consent_to_share" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("consent_to_share" IN (0, 1)), "submitted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("submitted" IN (0, 1)), "tested_at" INTEGER NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "emulator_profiles" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "emulator_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES emulators (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "console_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES consoles (id), "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "settings_json" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', "is_default" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_default" IN (0, 1)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "emulator_adapters" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "emulator_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES emulators (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "package_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "strategy" TEXT NOT NULL, "launch_mechanism" TEXT NULL, "installed_version" TEXT NULL, "installed" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("installed" IN (0, 1)), "last_detected_at" INTEGER NULL, UNIQUE ("emulator_id", "package_name"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "storage_devices" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "volume_id" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "description" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "tree_uri" TEXT NULL, "is_removable" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("is_removable" IN (0, 1)), "total_bytes" INTEGER NULL, "available_bytes" INTEGER NULL, "is_connected" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_connected" IN (0, 1)), "is_default" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_default" IN (0, 1)), "last_seen_at" INTEGER NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "game_files" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "game_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES games (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "uri" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "display_path" TEXT NOT NULL, "extension" TEXT NOT NULL, "size_bytes" INTEGER NULL, "sha1" TEXT NULL, "crc32" TEXT NULL, "storage_device_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES storage_devices (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "file_exists" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("file_exists" IN (0, 1)), "last_verified_at" INTEGER NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "game_metadata" ("game_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES games (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "description" TEXT NULL, "developer" TEXT NULL, "publisher" TEXT NULL, "release_date" TEXT NULL, "genre" TEXT NULL, "players" INTEGER NULL, "provider" TEXT NULL, "provider_id" TEXT NULL, "edited_manually" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("edited_manually" IN (0, 1)), "fetched_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("game_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "game_artworks" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "game_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES games (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "type" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("type" IN ('cover', 'screenshot', 'background')), "local_path" TEXT NOT NULL, "source_url" TEXT NULL, "provider" TEXT NULL, "fetched_at" INTEGER NOT NULL);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "favorites" ("game_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES games (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "added_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("game_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "game_history" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "game_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES games (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "emulator_id" TEXT NULL, "started_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "ended_at" INTEGER NULL, "duration_seconds" INTEGER NULL, "exit_status" TEXT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "controller_devices" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "descriptor" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "vendor_id" INTEGER NULL, "product_id" INTEGER NULL, "controller_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "has_vibrator" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("has_vibrator" IN (0, 1)), "buttons_json" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "axes_json" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "assigned_player" INTEGER NULL, "first_seen_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "last_seen_at" INTEGER NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "controller_profiles" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "controller_descriptor" TEXT NULL, "console_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES consoles (id), "dead_zone" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.15, "trigger_threshold" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.5, "vibration_enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("vibration_enabled" IN (0, 1)), "is_default" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_default" IN (0, 1)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "controller_mappings" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "profile_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES controller_profiles (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "action" TEXT NOT NULL, "key_code" INTEGER NULL, "axis" INTEGER NULL, "axis_direction" INTEGER NULL, UNIQUE ("profile_id", "action"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "source_connectors" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" TEXT NOT NULL, "description" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "game_sources" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "url" TEXT NOT NULL, "category" TEXT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("type" IN ('direct_url', 'homebrew_repo', 'public_domain_repo', 'authorized_distribution', 'personal_cloud', 'user_hosting', 'custom_http_api')), "description" TEXT NULL, "auth_type" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'none', "connector_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES source_connectors (id), "connection_status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'unknown', "last_checked_at" INTEGER NULL, "enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("enabled" IN (0, 1)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "download_queue" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "source_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES game_sources (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "url" TEXT NOT NULL, "destination" TEXT NOT NULL, "total_bytes" INTEGER NULL, "downloaded_bytes" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "status" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("status" IN ('queued', 'downloading', 'paused', 'completed', 'failed', 'cancelled')), "expected_hash" TEXT NULL, "hash_algorithm" TEXT NULL, "error_message" TEXT NULL, "retries" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "download_history" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "source_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES game_sources (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "url" TEXT NOT NULL, "destination" TEXT NOT NULL, "size_bytes" INTEGER NULL, "sha256" TEXT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "error_message" TEXT NULL, "finished_at" INTEGER NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "save_states" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "game_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES games (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "emulator_id" TEXT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("kind" IN ('state', 'native', 'memcard')), "slot" INTEGER NULL, "path" TEXT NOT NULL, "size_bytes" INTEGER NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "save_backups" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "game_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES games (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "save_state_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES save_states (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "backup_path" TEXT NOT NULL, "size_bytes" INTEGER NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "benchmarks" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "device_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES devices (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "emulator_id" TEXT NULL, "console_id" TEXT NULL, "game_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES games (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "benchmark_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "average_fps" REAL NULL, "minimum_fps" REAL NULL, "score" REAL NULL, "duration_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "ran_at" INTEGER NOT NULL);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "app_settings" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key"));
CREATE INDEX idx_hw_profiles_device ON device_hardware_profiles (device_id, scanned_at)
CREATE INDEX idx_compat_model ON device_compatibility (manufacturer, model)
CREATE INDEX idx_games_console ON games (console_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_games_last_played ON games (last_played_at)
CREATE INDEX idx_game_files_hash ON game_files (sha1)
CREATE INDEX idx_history_started ON game_history (started_at)
CREATE INDEX idx_download_status ON download_queue (status)
